name: DoomInDynamo
description: Plays Doom inside a Dynamo node, using the ManagedDoom engine rendered onto the node's face - and converts the current Revit model into a playable Doom map (RevitToWad.Export) with randomly placed items, wired straight into the player node's pwad input. You supply your own IWAD file - none is bundled. See https://github.com/ (update with your repo URL) for setup and licensing notes.
